events.reason: Roadmap Phase 1 item 1.3 (analysis_coverage — the honest-absence guarantee). Two rounds of pre-implementation research (spawned agents) revealed the roadmap's own design note assumed one shared 'analysis registry' checkable via Language_registry.lookup, but Go/Rust callgraph have separate standalone producer binaries entirely outside that registry, and effects/cfg/decisions/coverage/types are heterogeneous (three genuinely different availability-detection mechanisms, one analysis kind — decisions — not even part of the main dune build). Presented this finding to the user via AskUserQuestion; user chose full scope: build a real cross-producer registry/orchestrator rather than a narrowly-bounded slice. Scoped and documented per-kind in briefs/coverage-matrix-impl.md.

New analysis_coverage table (main schema, 1.4->1.5) + bin/arch_coverage_matrix binary + lib/arch_index/coverage_matrix.ml. Per-kind detection: OCaml callgraph/effects via bundled-executable + .cmt presence; Go/Rust callgraph via each wrapper script's own internal driver-path probe (a real bug caught manually before automated tests existed: an early draft checked the always-present wrapper script itself, not the driver it gates); every other Language_registry language via Language_registry.lookup; cfg/types derived from the callgraph row, not independently invoked; coverage requires --lcov; decisions (poc/decision-lint) always not_analysed since it is outside the main dune build. --allow-partial CLI flag with exit 1/0 semantics. must_null_ceiling ratchet recalibrated 289->321, verified against real query output. 102/102 tests pass, self-index golden regenerated.

reviewer + architect (cross-runtime codex skipped, degraded all session). Both independently found the same CRITICAL: repo_root computed as a single dirname hop landed inside _build/default, silently defeating all Go/Rust callgraph detection in every real invocation - fixed, but required a second pass (dune mirrors architecture-schema.sql into _build/default too) and new stub-based positive tests to actually catch it surviving the first fix. Second CRITICAL: an uncaught crash on symlinks under _build/default - fixed. 3 HIGH (no positive test for driver-built path, effects rows silently omitted for 4/6 languages contradicting the mli contract, Rust's second wrapper gate - the merge pass - not checked) and 3 MEDIUM (DDL duplication with a false equality claim, no transaction/checked binds in write_coverage, has_gap counting permanently-not_analysed cross-language rows) plus 1 LOW all fixed. architect confirmed the per-kind detection split is principled, not an excuse to under-deliver. 105/105 tests pass post-fix including two new real driver-built positive tests, self-index golden regenerated.

Build clean, 105/105 tests. No spec exists (Fast mode) so Step 3 was substituted with independent fresh-fixture reverification outside the review round's own test files: Rust with no driver anywhere (not_analysed, correct instruction), Rust with only the driver stub planted (not_analysed naming the merge pass specifically - confirms the review round's two-gate HIGH fix holds), and a clean single-language OCaml project (exit 0 in both a would-be-gap and clean scenario - confirms the has_gap MEDIUM fix holds). All three independently reconfirm the review round's fixes. Cross-runtime QA skipped (breaker: codex degraded, unchanged since review).
PR #57 merged (rebase-merge, 0c749c3). CI green on first attempt. Worktree/branch cleaned up post-merge.
